# Pricing Model (v2)

## 1. Tier Pricing (Monthly)

| Feature | **Starter (฿990)** | **Pro (฿2,990)** | **Business (฿5,990)** |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Users** | 3 | 10 | Unlimited |
| **Conversations** | 500 | 2,000 | Unlimited |
| **Unified Inbox** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| **CRM / POS** | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| **Ads Analytics** | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| **AI Assistants** | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| **Daily Sales Brief** | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ |

## 2. Industry Add-ons
- **🍳 Kitchen Ops**: +฿790/mo
- **🎓 Enrollment**: +฿790/mo
- **🤖 AI Agent**: +฿990/mo

## 3. Deployment Strategy
- **DEPA Voucher**: Pitch as "Free for 3 months" using Government stimulus.
- **Bundle Advantage**: ~70% cheaper than using 9 separate tools.
